name: FLASH_IMAGE_BAD
detection: POST S01: app image CRC32 or MCUboot signature trailer mismatch (bootloader writes the record to retained RAM)

name: BROWNOUT_RESET
detection: reset cause brown-out (`RESETREAS`, `POFCON` 2.7 V); ctx_a = VBUS mV after boot
text: Pod restarted after a power dip.

name: UICR_RESET_PIN_WRONG
detection: S03: `UICR.PSELRESET` is not P0.18 after `uicr_setup` retry, so the TPL5010 can not reset the MCU
text: Reset pin not set, watchdog can not reset the pod.

name: NVM_VERIFY_FAIL
detection: flash write read-back mismatch or erase error in the persistence task; ctx_a = page

name: NVM_WEAR_HIGH
detection: erase counter of a settings or log page above 8000 (of about 10000); ctx_a = count

name: RAIL_3V3_LOW
detection: SAADC internal VDD below 3.0 V (S04, every minute); ctx_a = mV

name: RAIL_3V3_HIGH
detection: VDD above 3.6 V; ctx_a = mV

name: DRIVER_FAULT_IN_BURST
detection: `EN/FAULT` (U4) low during a burst (over-current, thermal, UVLO); ctx_a = peak mA, ctx_c = step in burst

name: DRIVER_FAULT_AT_IDLE
detection: `EN/FAULT` low while `STBY` low and all gates open (net has a 10 k pull-up and must be high)

name: WDT_TIMING_FAULT
detection: `WDT_WAKE` interval measured with the RTC outside 1.4 to 2.6 s over 3 intervals, or no WAKE within 3 s (inst 1 no WAKE, 2 out of range); ctx_a = interval ms

name: WDT_RESET_INEFFECTIVE
detection: A08 service test: DONE withheld, MCU not reset within 3.5 s (RSTn path broken)
text: Watchdog can not reset the pod.

name: LATCH_CANNOT_CLEAR
detection: `LATCH_Q_MON` still high 1 ms after `LATCH_CLR_N` low

name: LATCH_CANNOT_SET
detection: `LATCH_Q_MON` low after an `ARM_CLK` edge with `MCU_EN` high (fail-safe direction)
text: Motor enable latch will not set.

name: LATCH_SET_WITHOUT_ARM
detection: `LATCH_Q_MON` high after reset (S05) or at an idle tick without an `ARM_CLK` edge
text: Motor enable latch set by itself.

name: VMOT_STUCK_ON
detection: `VMOT_SENSE` above 1.0 V for more than 50 ms while all gates are commanded open (S06 and every idle tick), or not below 0.5 V within `VMOT_FALL_TIMEOUT` after a disarm; ctx_a = mV

name: VMOT_NOT_PRESENT
detection: armed, VBUS ok, `VMOT_SENSE` below 3.0 V after `VMOT_SETTLE_MS`; ctx_a = mV
text: Motor supply does not come up.

name: VMOT_DROOP
detection: `VMOT_SENSE` below 85 % of `VBUS_SENSE` during a burst; ctx_a = permille

name: GATE_MCUEN_STUCK_PASS
detection: A01 and rotating disarm: cut with `MCU_EN` only, VMOT stays above 0.5 V; RB2/RB3 identify the gate

name: GATE_LATCH_STUCK_PASS
detection: A01 and rotating disarm: cut with `LATCH_CLR_N` only, VMOT stays above 0.5 V

name: GATE_DOCK_STUCK_PASS
detection: A02: undocked, DIR forward, armed, `MCU_EN` high: VMOT comes up (above 3.0 V); cut immediately

name: GATE_DIRREV_STUCK_PASS
detection: A02 with RB5 showing forward: gate passes anyway (reverse gate Q10/Q11 stuck)

name: GATE_MCUEN_STUCK_BLOCK
detection: `MCU_EN` high, latch armed, docked: RB2 stays high / VMOT absent while RB3 shows the other gates open
text: Motor enable gate will not open.

name: GATE_DOCK_STUCK_BLOCK
detection: hall says docked but `DOCKED_H` (RB4) low, or VMOT absent with RB4 low

name: GATE_INPUT_READBACK_MISMATCH
detection: own-pin readback of `MCU_EN`, `ARM_CLK`, `LATCH_CLR_N`, `STBY` or `WDT_DONE` differs from the driven level for 2 samples (inst = pin)

name: GATE_REVERSE_DOCKED_STUCK_PASS
detection: A13 (docked, `DOCK_TEST` off): reverse level, armed, `MCU_EN` high: VMOT comes up, or `PGATE_MON` low with `DOCKED_H` and `DIR_REV` both high (the XOR of the dock / DIR pair is lost, H14); cut immediately
text: Reverse while docked is not blocked.

name: ISENSE_IDLE_OFFSET
detection: `I_SENSE` with driver in STBY and gates open: more than 80 mV (about 8 mA at 10 V/A) in magnitude; ctx_a = mV

name: ISENSE_SATURATED
detection: `I_SENSE` at full scale (3.5 V or more) at idle, or during a burst with a free motor

name: ISENSE_DEAD
detection: 10 bursts in a row with moving angle and `I_SENSE` within 2 counts of the idle value

name: VOLTAGE_SENSE_IMPLAUSIBLE
detection: `VMOT/VBUS` outside 0.80 to 1.05 with Q4 on (inst 1), or `VBUS_SENSE` below 3.0 V while the MCU runs from USB (inst 2)

name: LFXO_NOT_RUNNING
detection: `LFCLKSTAT` source is not the crystal after 1 s; firmware falls back to the RC oscillator **and** raises this
text: Clock crystal not running (backup clock in use).

name: TIMEBASE_MISMATCH
detection: RTC (LF) against HF timer over 1 s differ by more than 0.5 %; ctx_a = ppm

name: ALARM_UNCONFIRMED
detection: A11: user answers in the app that no beep was heard (Rev A has no buzzer feedback)

name: TMAG_NO_ACK
detection: I2C NACK at 0x35 on 3 retries (S08). **Isolation:** if RB12 (FFC loop) is open the root is `3-30-001`, this record becomes its consequence

name: TMAG_ID_MISMATCH
detection: device or manufacturer id differs from expected (register map unverified: `TODO(verify-on-hardware)`); ctx_a = id read
text: Position sensor is not the expected part.

name: TMAG_FROZEN
detection: identical raw angle for 50 samples while at least 20 steps were executed

name: TMAG_CRC_ERRORS
detection: I2C CRC mode: more than 3 of 100 samples bad (W); more than 10 escalates to F

name: TMAG_DEVICE_STATUS
detection: TMAG device status bits set (supply UV, oscillator error; bit names to be verified); ctx_a = status
text: Position sensor reports an internal error.

name: DOCK_STUCK_DOCKED
detection: A10: input does not leave "docked" within 10 s after the lift request, or "docked" while a charger is present (Rev B)

name: DOCK_STUCK_UNDOCKED
detection: user confirmed docking, input stays undocked for 3 attempts while the FFC is fine

name: DOCK_CHATTER
detection: more than 6 transitions in 10 s (DRV5032FA threshold switches about 4 mm early, see STATUS)

name: QDEC_CROSSCHECK_FAIL
detection: only if the optional DRV5032 pair is fitted: edges per turn differ more than 25 % from the angle channel

name: FFC_ABSENT
detection: RB12 loop open **and** TMAG no ACK **and** `DOCK_N` high

name: FFC_INTERMITTENT
detection: 3 or more loss/recover events of RB12 or the TMAG ACK in 10 min (W); a loss during a burst escalates to F

name: I2C_BUS_STUCK
detection: SDA or SCL low for more than 1 ms and 9-clock recovery fails; ctx_a = line mask

name: FFC_DOCK_LINE_FAULT
detection: `DOCK_N` reads docked while RB12 is open, or while the TMAG does not ACK for 5 s (impossible combination)
text: Dock signal fault on the cable.

name: MOTOR_LEAD_OPEN
detection: burst with VMOT ok and no driver fault: `I_SENSE` peak below 15 % of the baseline, no angle motion; ctx_a = mA

name: MOTOR_PHASE_OPEN
detection: peak current 35 to 65 % of baseline and angle per pulse irregular (one coil open)

name: MOTOR_PHASE_SHORT
detection: `EN/FAULT` within 3 steps and peak at or above 1.5 x the chopper limit; ISOLATE: unplug the motor, re-run A03, fault persists means controller

name: MOTOR_CONTACT_INTERMITTENT
detection: 2 or more of 20 bursts with peak below 15 % of baseline while the others are normal

name: MOTOR_STALL_FREE
detection: stall where no downstream pressure can exist (draw reverse before the expected end stop, or forward in the first part of a stroke after a draw): angle below 50 % of commanded and current above the occlusion threshold

name: MOTOR_CURRENT_BASELINE_DRIFT
detection: free-run peak current outside +/- 25 % of the stored baseline (*cal*); ctx_a = mA, ctx_b = baseline

name: DIR_INVERTED
detection: A04: reverse pulses **increase** the angle or forward pulses decrease it; this also proves a wrong `DIR_REV` polarity option (R96/R97), which would let the undocked pod run forward

name: GEAR_BACKLASH_EXCESS
detection: dead travel at a direction change above 2 x the provisioned baseline; ctx_a = counts

name: GEAR_RATIO_MISMATCH
detection: A05: counts per pulse differ by more than 5 % from the drive calibration; ctx_c classifies: 1 power of two (MODE pins), 2 factor 0.8 or 1.25 (wrong gear pair, e.g. 18:18 fitted for 15:12), 3 other. A 25 % dosing error is otherwise silent
text: Gear ratio does not match the calibration.

name: GEAR_TOOTH_SKIP
detection: one angle-loss event of 1/12 screw turn (about 341 counts, +/- 20 %) or a multiple, otherwise normal motion

name: CARRIAGE_JAM_FWD
detection: forward stall **without** a pressure ramp: current at least doubles within one burst and the angle stops, on 2 retries (otherwise `5-53-*`)

name: CARRIAGE_FRICTION_HIGH
detection: free-run current more than 40 % above baseline along the stroke (*cal*)

name: TRAVEL_LENGTH_MISMATCH
detection: angle counts between the front and rear end stops differ more than 3 % from stroke x counts per mm (first full draw / provisioning)

name: RESERVOIR_EMPTY
detection: reservoir model at 0, front end stop, or a step vetoed by the model

name: RESERVOIR_LOW
detection: at or below the low level (default 10 U, configurable); ctx_a = mU

name: RESERVOIR_MODEL_MISMATCH
detection: front end stop reached with model above 2 U, or rear end stop in a draw with model room above 2 U

name: DRAW_NO_SOURCE
detection: reverse current above the threshold with less than 30 % of the requested volume drawn and no end stop expected (vacuum)

name: AIR_OR_LEAK_SUSPECTED
detection: A07: vacuum signature below 60 % of expected on a closed system, or a prime needs more than 2 x the baseline steps to build pressure (*cal*)
text: Air or a leak is suspected.

name: PLUNGER_FRICTION_PROFILE
detection: peak-to-mean current ratio over a stroke above 2.5 or local deviation above 40 % (stick-slip) (*cal*)

name: OCCLUSION_SHORTFALL
detection: (commanded minus angle-confirmed) above 2 U (spec section 7); ctx_a = mU

name: OCCLUSION_CURRENT_RISE
detection: 3 consecutive bursts above `OCCLUSION_CURRENT_MA` (140 mA placeholder, *cal*); ctx_a = mA

name: OCCLUSION_RAMP_WARNING
detection: burst peak current slope over 5 or more bursts above 3 x baseline slope while below the fault threshold (*cal*)

name: PRESSURE_ANOMALY_WHILE_DOCKED
detection: docked with the driver off: the angle moves against the self-locking drive or the supply current is not at its idle value, or a delivery stalls with a reservoir pressure signature that no commanded step explains (possible manual injection into the cannula, H15); ctx_a = angle counts, ctx_b = mA
text: Unexpected pressure while docked. Check the cannula and the pod.

name: ANGLE_CHANNEL_LOST
detection: `angle_read` returns `None` on 3 consecutive reads; **forwards the cause** (`7-79-001`, `3-30-*`, `2-20-*`)

name: FIELD_TOO_WEAK
detection: magnitude below 50 % of the stored nominal (S09 and continuous); ctx_a = LSB, ctx_b = nominal

name: FIELD_TOO_STRONG
detection: magnitude above 160 % of nominal or range saturated (extra magnet near the pod)
text: Position sensor sees a strong magnet.

name: ANGLE_NOISE_HIGH
detection: standard deviation over 32 samples at rest above 4 counts (W) or above 16 counts (F)

name: ANGLE_JUMP
detection: change of more than 2048 counts between 20 ms samples (unwrap invalid); ctx_a = counts

name: ENC_REV_DEVIATION
detection: angle per commanded leadscrew revolution outside 4096 +/- 3 % (`limits::REV_TOLERANCE_PCT`); ctx_a = counts

name: ENC_WINDOW_DEVIATION
detection: deviation above 10 % over a window of at least 1 U (spec section 7); ctx_a = permille
text: Delivered amount does not match steps.

name: UNCOMMANDED_MOTION
detection: net forward angle change above 40 counts (about 0.026 U on 15:12) within 10 s while the driver is in STBY and VMOT is verified off (back-driving: SCREW), or any motion while VMOT is present without a burst (interlock leak: CTRL)

name: CURRENT_OVER_LIMIT
detection: `I_SENSE` peak above 1.5 x the configured chopper limit

name: HOURLY_LIMIT_VETO
detection: supervisor: the 15 U rolling hour would be exceeded (the command layer should have refused first, so this is evidence of a bug)

name: PER_MINUTE_LIMIT_VETO
detection: more than 1.7 U/min (65 steps/min backstop on the 5:1 drive, scaled by calibration)

name: REQUEST_ABOVE_HARD_CAP
detection: delivery engine asked for a rate above 30 U/h or a bolus above 25 U

name: STEPS_EXCEED_APPROVAL
detection: executed steps (hardware TIMER1 count) exceed the steps the supervisor approved; ctx_a = executed, ctx_b = approved

name: STEPS_SHORT_OF_APPROVAL
detection: executed fewer than approved by more than 1 step (driver fault, VMOT not verified); cause chain to `1-03-*`, `3-31-*`, `1-06-*`

name: BOOKKEEPING_MISMATCH
detection: delivered total kept in two independent encodings (value and bitwise complement) differs, or the logged events do not add up to the counter

name: VETO_STEP_REQUEST_ILLEGAL
detection: engine requested a step while RELEASED, PAUSED_UNDOCKED, SUSPENDED or faulted (inst 1 to 4); the supervisor vetoed it. 3 in 10 min escalate to F
text: An internal check blocked an illegal step.

name: REVERSE_REQUESTED_WHILE_DOCKED
detection: a reverse step was requested (draw / assisted fill, take-up, engine) while the pod is docked; refused in firmware before any pin moves, in addition to the hardware XOR gate (H14)
text: An internal check blocked a reverse step while docked.

name: ENGINE_STATE_INVALID
detection: unreachable state or failed invariant in the delivery engine

name: BASAL_SCHEDULE_CORRUPT
detection: stored schedule CRC or segment ordering invalid
text: Basal schedule on the pod is invalid.

name: TIME_NOT_SET
detection: no `TIME_OF_DAY_MS` since boot; the schedule can not run

name: RES_MODEL_RECORD_CORRUPT
detection: stored fill record CRC fail

name: RES_MODEL_NEGATIVE
detection: consumed above filled, or level outside 0..capacity

name: DRAW_ABORTED
detection: draw ended early (inst 1 docked, 2 fault, 3 cancelled, 4 stall); ctx_a = drawn mU

name: DRAW_BLOCKED_NO_VMOT
detection: reverse burst executed 0 pulses because VMOT did not come up (bench interlock limitation, `stubs.md` conflict 2); cause chain to `1-06-002` or `1-07-006`
text: Refill not possible: motor supply blocked.

name: BOOT
detection: every boot: reset cause, FW version, POST-S summary in ctx

name: UNEXPECTED_RESET
detection: reset cause other than power-on or commanded (watchdog, brown-out, lockup, soft); ctx_a = `RESETREAS`, ctx_c = breadcrumb of the last task state. The pod boots SUSPENDED
text: Pod restarted unexpectedly and is suspended.

name: RESET_LOOP
detection: 3 or more unexpected resets in 60 min

name: PAIR_STATE_INCONSISTENT
detection: stored pair id, role, active flag and activation id contradict each other

name: POST_INCOMPLETE
detection: a POST-A step timed out or was aborted (inst = step)

name: POST_RESULT
detection: end of POST-S or POST-A: ctx_a = steps passed mask, ctx_b = steps failed mask

name: NVM_WRITE_TIMEOUT
detection: seq-ceiling write above 500 ms or persistence queue full; the command is refused
text: Pod storage is slow, command refused.

name: NVM_RECORD_CRC
detection: settings record (pod state, schedule, bonds) CRC fail (inst = key)

name: FAULT_LOG_RECORD_CRC
detection: fault-log item CRC bad; ctx_a = records lost
text: Part of the error log was unreadable.

name: SEQ_CEILING_UNREADABLE
detection: seq ceiling missing or CRC bad: a new session is required

name: INTERLOCK_FAILED_LATCH
detection: HAL `failed` state: supply not verified cut, DONE withheld, MCU reset by the TPL5010 within about 2 s; the cause chain points at `1-05-*`, `1-06-*` or `1-07-*`

name: INTERLOCK_SEQUENCE_TIMEOUT
detection: an interlock step (settle, STBY wake, EN/FAULT release) exceeded its timing constant

name: STEP_COUNT_SHORT
detection: TIMER1 count below the requested pulses, or burst timeout (n/rate + 25 ms); ctx_a = executed, ctx_b = requested
text: Motor did not complete its steps.

name: STEP_COUNT_EXTRA
detection: TIMER1 count above the requested pulses

name: PWM_NOT_STOPPED
detection: TIMER1 count still changing 5 ms after the burst ended

name: ADC_FAULT
detection: SAADC timeout, offset calibration failed, or all channels identical (inst 1, 2, 3)

name: I2C_ERROR_RATE
detection: TWIM errors (ANACK, DNACK, overrun) above 3 in 100 transfers; the cause chain continues in `3-30-*` or `2-20-*`

name: TRIAL_BOOT_REVERTED
detection: a new image was not confirmed and the bootloader reverted

name: TICK_OVERRUN
detection: safety tick delta above 2.5 s (nominal 1 s)

name: TICK_STALL
detection: tick delta at or above `TICK_MAX_DT` (5 s): the supervisor refuses the next steps

name: STACK_CANARY
detection: stack paint overwritten or high-water mark below 5 % free

name: PANIC
detection: panic handler ran: file/line hash in ctx_a, breadcrumb saved to retained RAM, MCU reset; the record is written at the next boot
text: Pod software error, restarted and suspended.

name: UNKNOWN_CODE_RAISED
detection: a raise with a code not in the catalogue; treated as F, FRU FW (never ignored)

name: LOG_UNAVAILABLE
detection: flash log write failed or CRC bad; the RAM ring keeps working
text: Error log can not be saved.

name: CAL_RECORD_INVALID
detection: drive calibration missing, CRC bad or outside 1 to 60 mU per step (inst 1, 2, 3). No step is ever approved; not acknowledgeable

name: CAL_PRESET_MISMATCH
detection: flash holds another preset than the build; the record is never overwritten
text: Drive calibration does not match this firmware.

name: TEST_CAL_IN_BUILD
detection: a test calibration (id at or above 0x7F00) is present in the preset table at startup

name: LINK_QUALITY_DEGRADED
detection: more than 10 frame, length or CRC errors per minute

name: VERSION_MISMATCH
detection: frame version other than 1, or the diag schema is not understood
text: Pod and app versions do not match.

name: AUTH_OR_REPLAY_BURST
detection: 3 or more CCM tag failures (inst 1) or 5 or more replay rejects (inst 2) per minute
text: The pod rejected commands from a phone.

name: SESSION_EXHAUSTED
detection: `seq` reached 0xFFFE, rekey needed

name: NO_SESSION_KEY
detection: production build has no key agreement (current stub: every frame is answered AUTH)
text: Pod can not be controlled: no secure key.

name: RNG_FAILURE
detection: RNG health test failed at boot

name: MTU_TOO_SMALL
detection: negotiated MTU below 247, frames cannot fit

name: NOTIFY_QUEUE_OVERFLOW
detection: the alert queue (8 entries) dropped the oldest; the app resyncs with `GetFaultLog`
text: Some pod alerts were missed, the app will refresh.

name: BOND_LOST
detection: the app has no matching bond or the key does not match
text: The pod no longer trusts this phone.

name: PUMP_UNREACHABLE
detection: no response from the pod for 5 min while active

name: DELIVERY_UNCERTAIN
detection: link lost while a bolus or cancel was in flight; the existing recovery flow reconciles with `GetStatus`
text: Unsure whether the last bolus was delivered.

name: SWAP_OLD_POD_UNCONFIRMED
detection: `Release` of the old pod not confirmed (existing alert `swapOldPodUnconfirmed`)

name: TWO_ACTIVE_PODS
detection: both pods report ACTIVE or delivering (existing alert `podConflict`)

name: HANDOVER_TOTALS_MISMATCH
detection: `ACT_DELIVERED_MU` of the old pod differs from the app ledger by more than 0.15 U or 5 %
text: Delivered amount of the old pod does not match.

name: SHARED_PART_SUSPECT
detection: the same fault class on pod A and pod B within 24 h: suspect the shared cannula or the phone, not the pods
text: Both pods report the same problem.

name: SPARE_NOT_READY
detection: the spare pod has an F or L record, a low level, or only a stale red cached state (existing alert `spareNotReady` extended)
text: The spare pod is not ready.

name: CAL_UNKNOWN
detection: `DRIVE_CAL` missing, zero or not a known (id, uU per step) pair (existing `calibration` alert)

name: CAL_CHANGED
detection: `DRIVE_CAL` of a known pod UID differs from the stored one (pod rebuilt or drive swapped)

name: DOSE_LEDGER_MISMATCH
detection: pod `DELIVERED_MU` against the app ledger differs by more than 0.15 U or 5 %
text: Delivered insulin does not match the records.

name: ALERTS_NOT_DELIVERABLE
detection: notifications or critical alerts are switched off, so pod alarms may be missed
text: Notifications are off, alarms may be missed.

name: POD_FW_UNSUPPORTED
detection: pod firmware older than the app minimum
text: Pod firmware too old for this app.

name: UNKNOWN_POD_CODE
detection: the pod reported a code that is not in the app's catalogue; the record's own severity, FRU and action are used and the raw code is shown
text: Unknown pod error, update the app.

name: BATTERY_LOW
detection: at or below 3.5 V (`BATTERY_LOW_MV`, 100 mV hysteresis); inst 1 = bench VBUS source

name: BATTERY_CRITICAL
detection: below 3.3 V (`BATTERY_CRITICAL_MV`); inst 1 = bench VBUS source; blocks resume until recovered

name: BATTERY_OVERVOLT
detection: Rev B: cell above 4.3 V or below 2.5 V persistently

name: CHARGER_FAULT
detection: Rev B: charge controller fault or charge timeout

name: USB_SUPPLY_LOW
detection: bench: `VBUS_SENSE` below 4.4 V (the 3.5 V and 3.3 V levels use `A-A0-001/002` with inst 1)

name: USB_OVERVOLT
detection: `VBUS_SENSE` above 5.6 V

name: TEMP_HIGH_WARN
detection: die temperature above 37 deg C (proxy; ambient not measured; *cal*); ctx_a = 0.25 deg C

name: TEMP_HIGH_STOP
detection: die temperature above 42 deg C (*cal*): delivery suspended

name: TEMP_LOW
detection: die temperature below 5 deg C

name: TEMP_SENSOR_IMPLAUSIBLE
detection: frozen reading for 10 min or outside -20 to 85 deg C

name: WEAR_WARNING
detection: 44 h since `Activate` (existing flag bit 8 and event 22)

name: WEAR_EXPIRED
detection: 52 h since `Activate` (legacy bit 7): delivery stops; cleared by `Activate`
